topic: The city buried alive and perfectly preserved for 2000 years
hook: A city was buried alive and preserved perfectly for 2000 years.
script: A city was buried alive and preserved perfectly for 2000 years. In 79 AD, Mount Vesuvius erupted and buried Pompeii in ash within hours. Bodies frozen mid-step. Food still on tables. Graffiti on walls. Even a dog chained at a door. When excavated 1700 years later, it was a perfect time capsule of Roman life. Follow for history secrets hidden beneath our feet.
